name: Dullahan

actions.name: Vorpal Blade
actions.effect: On a critical hit, the target must pass PHYS save or be decapitated (instant death for creatures without legendary resistance or equivalent).

actions.name: Death's Gaze
actions.effect: The Dullahan holds up its severed head and calls a creature's name. That creature must pass WILL save or be frightened and have their max HP reduced by 3d8. If max HP reaches 0, the creature dies.

actions.name: Nightmare Charge
actions.effect: The Dullahan charges on its spectral horse up to 18m in a straight line. All creatures in the path must pass PHYS save or take damage and be knocked prone.

reactions.name: Deathly Aura
reactions.effect: When a creature within 6m is healed, the Dullahan can negate the healing entirely.

reactions.name: Mounted Dodge
reactions.effect: The Dullahan's nightmare steed rears, granting +4 to all defenses against one attack.

traits.name: Headless Horror
traits.desc: The Dullahan carries its own severed head. It can see through the head's eyes regardless of where the head is. Cannot be blinded while holding the head.

traits.name: Nightmare Steed
traits.desc: The Dullahan rides a spectral black horse. The steed has no separate stats but grants the Dullahan enhanced mobility and the Nightmare Charge action.

traits.name: Death Omen
traits.desc: Creatures that see the Dullahan for the first time must pass WILL save or be frightened for 1 round.

lore: The Dullahan is a headless rider of Celtic legend, an omen of death itself. When it stops riding and speaks a mortal's name, that person's life is forfeit. Its whip is a human spine, and its coach is adorned with funeral objects.
